description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Freya], [Apex Dragon's Crest Ability Tracker] and [Apex Dragon's Crest Level]

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Freya
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Dragon's Crest (0~2), removed after using Apex Dragon's Crest two times

description.name: Apex Dragon's Crest Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Dragon's Crest level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Dragoon or Dancer abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Freya]

description.name: Apex Dragon's Crest Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Dragon's Crest level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Freya]
